name: O Espectro de Bongcheon-Dong
source: A short Brazilian horror VN in RPG Maker VX Ace, based on the original webtoon by [url=http://comic.naver.com/webtoon/detail.nhn?titleId=350217&no=31]Horang[/url], which is itself based on a Korean urban legend and supposed "true personal accounts".
translation: 一部使用RPG Maker VX Ace制作的巴西短篇恐怖视觉小说，改编自[url=http://comic.naver.com/webtoon/detail.nhn?titleId=350217&no=31]Horang[/url]创作的原版网络漫画；该漫画本身又取材于韩国都市传说和所谓的“真实亲身经历”。
